body: Every Airbus A350 ever built flies with the same engine. Over more than a decade of production and with more than 60 airline customers, no operator has had a choice, a contrast with the Boeing 777 and 787 Dreamliner, which offer customers a choice between General Electric and Rolls-Royce engines. That outcome was not Airbus' preference: General Electric was prepared to supply an engine for the A350-900 and refused to build one for the stretched A350-1000, because the larger aircraft competes directly against the GE-powered Boeing 777. With GE unwilling to cover the full family, Rolls-Royce became the only manufacturer willing to develop an engine specifically for the aircraft, and the arrangement has since been locked in by contract through 2030.

GE had offered a derivative of its GEnx engine family, already selected for the Boeing 787, for the A350-900, but it would not build the higher-thrust engine the A350-1000 required. GE is the sole engine supplier for the Boeing 777-200LR and 777-300ER through the GE90, and developing a 97,000 lb thrust engine for Airbus would have given airlines a GE-powered alternative to the GE-powered 777, cannibalizing a franchise GE already owned outright. Rolls-Royce instead designed the Trent XWB for the A350, powering the A350-900 and A350-1000 at 84,000 lb and 97,000 lb of thrust, with the Trent XWB-97 re-engineered with a larger core, new intermediate-pressure compressor stages and improved cooling to manage higher thermal loads.

Rolls-Royce held exclusivity on the A350-1000 from the start, and on March 11, 2021, during its FY2020 results presentation, it announced that Airbus had extended the A350-900 agreement by five years, taking the Trent XWB-84 to 2030 as the sole powerplant on the variant that accounts for the bulk of the fleet; the previous agreement had been due to expire in 2025. Then-chief executive Warren East said: “We’re already exclusive on the A350-1000, and extending our position on the A350-900 variant, which accounts for the bulk of the A350 fleet, out to 2030 is in line with the development timeline for our next-generation UltraFan engine program.” More than 2,600 Trent XWB engines are in service or on order across over 60 airline customers, and by 2021 the fleet had already accumulated more than seven million flight hours, six years after entry into service.

For airlines, the single engine type simplifies logistics, maintenance and customer support, since an A350 operator maintains one engine type rather than the duplicate inventories and training programs a mixed-engine 777 or 787 fleet requires; LATAM's general terms agreement, for example, covers engines for 27 A350 family aircraft and up to seven spare engines, plus a rate-per-flight-hour shop maintenance agreement with Rolls-Royce TotalCare Services. The exclusivity agreement runs to 2030, and the A350 could technically be dual-sourced from 2031, but the original reason GE declined has not changed, UltraFan remains a technology demonstrator rather than a production engine, and Rolls-Royce's stated priority is now making its existing engines perform better and last longer, with the Trent XWB-84 EP having received EASA certification.
en.summary: General Electric would supply an engine for the A350-900 but not the larger A350-1000, which competes with its own GE-powered Boeing 777. Rolls-Royce's Trent XWB therefore became the family's sole powerplant, with exclusivity on the A350-900 extended to 2030.
en.title: Why every A350 flies on one engine: GE walked away from the A350-1000, leaving Rolls-Royce alone until 2030

body: 空中巴士至今生產的每一架A350都使用同一款發動機。量產十多年、客戶超過60家航空公司，沒有任何業者有選擇餘地，這與波音777與787夢幻客機不同，後兩者讓客戶在奇異與勞斯萊斯之間選擇。這並非空中巴士的偏好：奇異原本願意為A350-900供應發動機，卻拒絕為加長型的A350-1000打造發動機，因為該機型直接與奇異動力的波音777競爭。奇異不願涵蓋全系列之後，勞斯萊斯成為唯一願意專為該機型開發發動機的製造商，相關安排也已透過合約鎖定至2030年。

奇異曾提出以已獲波音787選用的GEnx系列衍生型供應A350-900，但不願打造A350-1000所需的較高推力發動機。奇異透過GE90獨家供應波音777-200LR與777-300ER的發動機，為空中巴士開發97000磅推力的發動機，等於給航空公司一個奇異動力的替代選項，去取代奇異動力的777，侵蝕奇異已完全擁有的市場。勞斯萊斯則專為A350設計遄達XWB，以84000磅與97000磅推力分別供應A350-900與A350-1000，其中遄達XWB-97經過重新設計，採用較大的核心、新的中壓壓縮機級數與改良的冷卻系統，以承受較高的熱負荷。

勞斯萊斯自始即獨家供應A350-1000的發動機，並於2021年3月11日在2020財年業績發表會上宣布，空中巴士已把A350-900協議延長五年，使遄達XWB-84成為占機隊多數的該機型的唯一動力至2030年，原協議則將於2025年到期。當時的執行長華倫伊斯特表示，延長安排符合下一代UltraFan發動機計畫的發展時程。目前服役中或已訂購的遄達XWB超過2600具，客戶超過60家，至2021年機隊在投入服務六年後已累積超過700萬飛行小時。

對航空公司而言，單一發動機機型簡化了後勤、維修與客戶支援，A350業者只需維護一種發動機，而不必像混合發動機的777或787機隊那樣準備重複的庫存與訓練計畫；例如拉塔姆航空的通用條款協議涵蓋27架A350系列飛機的發動機與最多7具備用發動機，以及與勞斯萊斯TotalCare服務的按飛行小時計費維修協議。獨家協議至2030年屆滿，A350在技術上可自2031年起改採雙來源，但奇異當年拒絕的理由並未改變，UltraFan目前仍是技術驗證機而非量產發動機，勞斯萊斯現階段的優先工作是讓現有發動機表現更好、壽命更長，遄達XWB-84EP也已取得歐洲航空安全局認證。
zh.summary: 奇異願意為A350-900供應發動機，卻不願為與自家波音777競爭的加長型A350-1000造發動機。勞斯萊斯遄達XWB因而成為全系列唯一動力，A350-900的獨家協議也已延長至2030年。
